svg.title: Same MLA operation, two ways to evaluate retained state
svg.desc: Toy: H = 2; latent/content/value/position widths = 2; FP64; query sees positions 0 and 1
svg.text: Same MLA operation, two ways to evaluate retained state
Toy: H = 2; latent/content/value/position widths = 2; FP64; query sees positions 0 and 1
Retain one content latent c and one positional key r per token
The positional vectors are supplied after their transform; they are not optional.
Materialized path: expand per-head content K and V
Apply each head’s Uᴷ and Uⱽ to every c, then score and aggregate values.
Each score includes content dot + positional dot, divided by 2.
Absorbed path: transform the query and aggregate latents
q̃ = (Uᴷ)ᵀqᶜ; score against c plus the same positional term.
For each head: a = sum of attention-weighted c; output = Uⱽa.
Original query case: equal weights, different head outputs
Both heads have weights (0.5,0.5), and latent aggregate (0.5,0.5).
Equivalent relative to the same MLA contract; this is not a lossless conversion of arbitrary MHA state.
